title: Mouse Highlighter conflicting with highlight mode : Ripple

status.label: Fix plan ready for design
status.detail: Ghost circle highlight artifact remains visible when switching Highlight mode to Ripple.

next_action.label: Design fix
next_action.reason: Ensure active overlay canvas and highlight drawing resources are cleared when mode changes.

judgment.rationale: The issue has verified, reproducible steps and attached diagnostic logs confirming that changing Mouse Highlighter mode from Circle Highlighting to Ripple fails to clear the active circle drawing overlay.
evidence: Detailed 7-step reproduction provided with screenshots and attached PowerToys diagnostic ZIP archive.
Switching highlight mode in Settings from Circle Highlighting to Ripple leaves the previous circle highlight overlay frozen at the last mouse click coordinates.
Subsequent clicks in Ripple mode do not dismiss the stale circle highlight canvas.
judgment.recommended_action: Design and implement cleanup logic in Mouse Highlighter to dismiss active circle overlays upon highlight mode change.

fix_assessment.rationale: No existing PR or fix covers clearing stale circle highlight overlays on mode change.

issue_context.summary: Mouse Highlighter leaves a frozen circle overlay on screen when switching mode from Circle Highlighting to Ripple.
known_information: Reported on Windows 11 with PowerToys v0.101.2362 and v0.101.2522.
Confirmed with screenshots and attached PowerToysReport ZIP.
Steps: Enable Mouse Highlighter -> Circle mode -> click screen -> switch to Ripple mode -> circle stays stuck.
inferences: The mode switch updates configuration but does not force a redraw or hide the overlay window of the previous mode.
issue_context.analysis: The public evidence contains exact reproduction steps and screenshots. A code fix can be designed directly to clear the overlay upon mode transition.
initial_investigation: Read full issue report, screenshot attachments, and comment discussion through 2026-09-12T02:35:44Z.
Identified Mouse Utilities / Mouse Highlighter module as the owning component.

actions.label: Design fix
actions.note: Approve a focused fork-side design investigation; this action does not write upstream.

reproduce.title: Reproduce ghost circle highlight on mode switch
steps: Set Highlight mode to Circle Highlighting.
Click anywhere on the screen to show the circular highlight.
Change Highlight mode to Ripple in Settings.
Observe screen: check if circular highlight remains stuck.
reproduce.expected_result: Circle highlight disappears immediately upon switching mode and does not remain as a ghost image.

proposed_fixes.title: Clear active drawing overlay when switching Mouse Highlighter mode
proposed_fixes.root_cause: When changing Highlight mode from Circle Highlighting to Ripple, the existing circle drawing overlay window/canvas is not reset or hidden, leaving stale GDI/Direct2D render content on screen.
plan: Locate highlight mode change notification handler in Mouse Highlighter module.
Ensure active overlay window is hidden or redrawn clean before initializing the ripple animation canvas.
Verify switching between all highlight modes clears previous overlays cleanly.
verification: Follow the 7-step reproduction sequence and verify no ghost circle remains when switching to Ripple mode.
Test switching back and forth between Circle, Ripple, and other highlighter modes.

confidence.rationale: The reproduction steps and visual evidence are deterministic, but module code inspection is needed to locate the exact overlay cleanup hook.
